content:
leila_engineering: Hi all - my March net was ~£950 lower. Payslip shows US federal withholding and a line for CA state tax. Im UK-based (London) and transitioned from a US role last year. I uploaded my W-8BEN last month but still seeing US/CA lines. Any idea why?

sam_payroll: Sorry about that. Can you paste the redacted payslip snippet? Also when did you upload the W-8BEN and what country code is in HRIS? Sometimes the W-8 isn't flagged until payroll syncs.

leila_engineering: Redacted: 
Gross: £6,400.00
UK income tax: £1,600.00
Employee NI: £520.00
US federal tax: £760.00
CA state tax: £170.00
Net: £3,250.00
I uploaded W-8BEN on 2026-01-12 and HRIS shows country=GB. My work visa is UK. I did a two-week onsite in SF in Nov but nothing since.

harper_hr: I see W-8BEN doc attached in your profile, thanks. However your "tax residency" flag in HRIS is still set to US due to a legacy onboarding record. That flag controls our payroll country mapping for some UK/US hybrid employees. I'll update it to GB and add a note.

dana_finance: Important: work performed in CA can create nexus and withholding obligations even for nonresidents. If wages were earned while physically present in CA, CA withholding can apply. For the US federal line, if we inadvertently had you on US payroll file, funds may have been remitted to IRS. Sam, was the US payroll file submitted for the March run?

payroll-bot: Payroll run 2026-03-31 processed. Batch id pr-20260331-3310. Outgoing remittance files generated for GB RTI and US payroll channels.

sam_payroll: Confirmed: the US channel received a record for Leila in the March run. Remittance files were created 2026-03-31; bank settlement to US processor shows initiation 2026-04-01. That means reversal depends on whether funds cleared the processor. If funds are still recoverable we can do an off-cycle reversal; if already settled well need to coordinate reclaim and possibly advise on IRS refund claim.

leila_engineering: Ugh. I didnt expect CA withholding at all. For the SF trip in Nov it was under 10 working daysshouldnt trigger CA withholding for the March wages.

harper_hr: The SF trip shouldn't affect March pay unless time entries were miscoded to CA payroll project. I'll audit your timesheet allocations for March to ensure no CA-coded days.

sam_payroll: Next steps: (1) HR will confirm residency flag update and timesheet audit; (2) Payroll will attempt an off-cycle reversal for the US and CA lines (ticket PAY-ADJ-8122); (3) Finance will advise on remittance status and refund paths if reversal not possible. If we can reverse before settlement cutoff (2026-04-03 17:00 BST for international files) employee won't need to take action.

dana_finance: If reversal not possible and funds were remitted to US/CA, we will attempt to recover via our payment processor. If recovery fails, we will either gross-up or issue an interim reimbursement depending on payroll policy and hardship. Also, note at year-end we must ensure no W-2 is produced for UK payroll employees; if records temporarily appeared on US files we may need to correct before W-2 issuance.

leila_engineering: Appreciate the plan. Please let me know if I should file anything with the IRS or CA Franchise Tax Board in the short term. I haven't filed any US returns for this tax year.

sam_payroll: If we successfully reverse before remittance, no action required. If remittance already occurred and recovery fails, we'll give you documentation and next steps to claim refunds (Form 843 for federal refund, CA form FTB-3506 claim, etc.) and coordinate with tax counsel. We'll also support any forms you need to complete (W-8BEN confirmation, residency affidavit).

harper_hr: Ill update your HR record now and DM you a quick residency affidavit to sign. Also adding a step in the onboarding checklist: clear legacy US tax flags when W-8BEN is uploaded.

payroll-bot: PAY-ADJ-8122 created and assigned to sam_payroll. Estimated resolution: 2026-04-09.

leila_engineering: Thank you all. I'll watch the thread and ping if I see further discrepancies on April payslip. :heart:
